name: Per-agent limit on claimed, undelivered tasks, blocked-task hard cap, and per-agent claim lock
summary: Each personal agent carries an owner-editable claim_limit (1..50, default 1, lowerable by the agent itself via PATCH /v1/agents/me) enforced in the HTTP service's tasks.claim route and on an agent's self-assignment in tasks.assign under a per-agent reentrant lock (Service.claim_gate(agent_id)). A task counts against claim_limit while it is assigned to the agent's actor or a <agent>/<label> sub-label (claim_limit.actor_holds), open or in_progress, and its review state is none or changes-requested (or unknown, fail-closed), unless its newest valid checkpoint declares a blocker or dependency item. To bound self-blocking loops without breaking the worker order of checkpointing a blocked task and moving on, a hard cap of claim_limit + 3 (BLOCKED_SLACK = 3, hard_cap(limit)) counts all undelivered claims including blocked ones; a refused claim answers 409 conflict with held, blocked, claim_limit and hard_cap in detail. /v1/agents/me and /v1/agents/me/next report the same claim_limit view (limit, hard_cap, held, blocked, available, counts_task, raise_by), and the agent's owner or a project coordinator can release one or all of the agent's undelivered claims.
